emojis.name: FireCape
emojis.notes: Static fire cape sprite. The previous emoji was animated; this application emoji is a still image.

emojis.name: gear
emojis.notes: Custom gear-score icon. The equipment-tab graphic is a full panel, not an emoji.

emojis.name: Huge_lamp
emojis.notes: OSRS antique lamp, the standard XP lamp. The original emoji was custom 'huge lamp' art.

emojis.name: Ikkle_hydra
emojis.notes: Default serpentine Ikkle hydra. The wiki has no unsuffixed sprite.

emojis.name: Item_contract
emojis.notes: Custom item-contract scroll. The RuneScape Wiki item-protection contract is a different item.

emojis.name: Kalphite_princess_2nd_form
emojis.notes: Flying (second) form of the Kalphite Princess.

emojis.name: Leagues
emojis.notes: Official OSRS Leagues icon. The old EmojiId.Leagues constant is unused by commands.

emojis.name: Magicmastercape
emojis.notes: OSRS magic cape. BSO master-cape art is custom and is not on the wiki.

emojis.name: MoneyBag
emojis.notes: OSRS Coins (1000) sack, used as the money-bag icon.

emojis.name: Monkey_crate
emojis.notes: Custom BSO monkey crate. The wiki crate is the monkey-dentures crate, a different item.

emojis.name: runecraftMasterCape
emojis.notes: OSRS runecraft cape. BSO master-cape art is custom and is not on the wiki.

emojis.name: Skull
emojis.notes: OSRS skull item. The original badge art was custom.

emojis.name: slayerMasterCape
emojis.notes: OSRS slayer cape. BSO master-cape art is custom and is not on the wiki.

emojis.name: Smokey
emojis.notes: Custom pet (slots). Separate art from the lowercase smokey emoji.
